# Phase 7 additive core seam verification

Changes are uncommitted and scoped to the assigned core/model/command APIs and shared tests. No dependencies added.

- into-storage-red.txt / into-storage-green.txt: compiling consuming-storage regression RED then GREEN.
- proposed-ids-red.txt / proposed-ids-model-green.txt: exact proposed-ID model regression RED then GREEN.
- proposed-ids-owner-behavior-red.txt / proposed-ids-owner-green-final.txt: compiling owner exact-ID RED then two GREEN cases. Earlier owner-red/green setup files had compile failures and are not behavioral evidence.
- status-red.txt / status-green.txt: persisted retry/status RED then GREEN.
- passive-merge-behavior-red.txt / passive-merge-green-attempt.txt: real passive offer stub RED then shared memory GREEN. Earlier passive-merge-red.txt failed on a fixture dependency expectation, not passive behavior.
- core-regression.txt: 84 core unit tests passed.
- shared-and-pull-regression-final.txt: 29 tests passed (memory 5 entity + 1 shared + 8 pull; protected SQLite 5 entity + 1 shared + 9 pull), including trigger failure retry/reopen in shared wrapper. The first fault fixture observed membership only and failed its field-change event assertion; corrected to columns(body).
- shared-final-verified.txt: final expanded shared matrix passed 1 per adapter, adding queue-only receipt invalidation and hidden optimistic no-op/deletion/tombstone behavior. An initial receipt fixture used an invalid unversioned command name; corrected without production change.
- clippy-final.txt: core/memory/SQLite all-target Clippy -D warnings passed. Later final formatting/check files supersede this if present.

Implementation preserves command local: recovery prefix; the operator TC-0016 clarification is not silently adopted. DiagnosticSnapshot remains the original ten fields. Passive hooks share the existing validator and ordinary pull planner; no foreign callback or stored global permit exists.

Final additive normalization seam after reviewed prep716d7bd: normalization-red.txt genuine compiling mismatch (local alias not canonical mapped ID), normalization-green.txt shared tests PASS both adapters. Delegates are readonly/table-aware and expose only supplied application values; unconfigured fields remain untouched. final-fmt is recorded under ../phase-seven-entities; final-clippy there covers all four affected crates after helper changes. wasm.txt core+memory target build passed before this final readonly addition; root owns final all-source WASM gate.
